From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC plan & next steps - FinLytics

Hi Jordan / Priya 

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps to get the POC kicked off:

What we covered
- Goals: validate latency & cost for 3 production queries, evaluate semantic search quality on historical support tickets, and verify integration with your data access patterns.
- Success criteria (initial): average 95th percentile latency < 250ms for short queries, embedding recall >= 0.78 on sample set, and no PII leaks in logs for the POC dataset.

Proposed POC plan (2 weeks)
1) Week 1  Setup: data access, test dataset (20k docs), model selection and baseline runs. Owners: Marissa (Redwood), Jordan (FinLytics).
2) Week 2  Eval & tuning: run batch evals, tweak batching/quantization profiles, run integration tests. Owners: Marcus (Redwood), Priya (FinLytics).

Deliverables
- Shared POC plan (attached)
- SOC2 summary & evidence checklist (attached)
- Evaluation script and metric definitions in shared Drive link

Action items / asks
- Jordan: confirm dataset access method (S3 role or secure upload) and point person for data access by Tue 16 Feb.
- Priya: confirm evaluation priority queries and owner for quality sign-off.
- FinLytics: sign off on the attached POC plan so we can schedule the environment.

I attached the POC plan and our SOC2 summary for your security/infosec team. If this looks good, I can loop in Monica (CS) to schedule the kickoff and Marcus to own model tuning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Marissa  thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Dataset access: we prefer S3 role; I'll get our infra person to create a role scoped to the test bucket. Targeting Tue 16 Feb but could be Wed depending on approvals.
- Success criteria: the latency and embedding recall targets look good. One ask: can we add throughput target for peak spikes (500 qps sustained for 2m) to the evaluation?
- Timeline: 2-week window is fine but can we add a short follow-up week (week 3) for any tuning and handover if needed.

Priya and I will confirm the priority query list by EOD Tue. Can you confirm the data retention and logs behavior during the POC for compliance? We may need that for our security team.

Thanks  Jordan

Jordan  great, thanks. Answers inline below and updated plan notes: 

- S3 role: yes, that works. Once you share the role ARN we'll validate access.
- Throughput spike target: added to the evaluation plan (we'll include a 500 qps spike test).
- Data retention / logs: by default Redwood does not persist raw customer inputs in the hosted logs for POCs. For this trial we will:
  - Retain aggregated telemetry and metrics only (latency, error rates)
  - Redact payloads that match PII patterns; full payload retention can be enabled only under a contract and customer-managed KMS if required.

Attached is an updated POC plan (v1.1) with throughput test and a short week-3 handover slot.

Proposed kickoff: Thu 18 Feb 09:00 PT  30m initial sync to confirm access and owners. Monica will send a calendar invite if that works.

Please reply with confirmation on Thu 18 kickoff or suggest alternate time.

Cheers,
Marissa

Hi Jordan / Priya 

Quick weekly status following our kickoff and first runs:

What we completed- S3 role verified and sample dataset (5k docs) ingested- Baseline smoke run completed: median latency 180ms, 95th 260ms on short queries (note: near the threshold)- Embedding quality: preliminary recall 0.74 on the first sample set

Blockers / asks

- Dev team: can you confirm whether the S3 role will have read-only access to the bucket (preferred) or if you'll push a short-term signed upload? This impacts how we run incremental pulls.

Next steps
- Marcus to run performance tuning passes Friday (quantization + batching adjustments).
- Monica to share the first weekly status note and evaluation run links by EOD Tue.

If we don't get the priority query list by Tue end-of-day, the full eval will slip by ~3 business days. Can you confirm?

Thanks 
